articles.title: Attackers Target Rejetto HFS Flaw That Enables Admin Session Forgery and RCE
articles.executive_summary: Attackers are actively exploiting a critical vulnerability in Rejetto HTTP File Server (HFS) that enables admin session forgery and remote code execution. This flaw allows unauthorized access and can lead to significant operational risks.
articles.technical_breakdown: The vulnerability stems from a weak pseudo-random number generator (PRNG) that generates a predictable key, enabling attackers to forge admin sessions and execute remote code.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the latest patch for Rejetto HFS to address the vulnerability
Implement network containment or firewall rules to block unauthorized access
Monitor logs for suspicious activity and implement detection indicators
articles.telegram_snippet: Rejetto HFS vulnerability (CVE-2026-61500) under active exploitation, enabling admin session forgery and RCE. Patch immediately to mitigate operational risks.

articles.title: New NetScaler Zero-Day Exploited in Targeted Attacks Can Knock SAML Deployments Offline
articles.executive_summary: New NetScaler Zero-Day Exploited in Targeted Attacks Can Knock SAML Deployments Offline. Citrix has released security updates for a high-severity security flaw in NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway that has been exploited as part of targeted zero-day attacks.
articles.technical_breakdown: Analysis of incident reported by The Hacker News. The threat involves attack vectors targeting Citrix. Further technical telemetry is developing.
actionable_mitigations: Review firewall and perimeter access logs for anomalous traffic patterns.
Verify all endpoint detection (EDR) agents are updated with latest behavioral signatures.
Audit exposed external assets and apply vendor security patches immediately.

articles.title: Citrix patches NetScaler SAML zero-day exploited in attacks
articles.executive_summary: Citrix has released emergency updates for a NetScaler denial-of-service vulnerability (CVE-2026-88779) that has been exploited in zero-day attacks. Researchers are investigating whether the vulnerability can also be exploited for remote code execution.
articles.technical_breakdown: The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-88779, is a NetScaler SAML denial-of-service vulnerability that has been exploited in zero-day attacks. The exact exploitation mechanics and root cause are still being investigated.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the emergency updates released by Citrix
Implement network containment or firewall rules to block unauthorized access to NetScaler systems
Monitor logs for signs of exploitation and implement detection indicators
articles.telegram_snippet: Citrix has patched a NetScaler SAML zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-88779) exploited in attacks, with researchers investigating RCE potential.

articles.title: Google halts open-source bug bounty program amid AI spam surge
articles.executive_summary: Google has suspended its open-source bug bounty program due to a surge in AI-generated reports, potentially leaving vulnerabilities unaddressed. This highlights the growing challenge of AI-powered attacks on cybersecurity programs.
articles.technical_breakdown: The AI-generated reports overwhelmed the program, exploiting its open nature to submit fake vulnerability reports. This highlights the need for more sophisticated filtering mechanisms to prevent such spam.
actionable_mitigations: Review and validate all submissions manually
Implement AI-detection tools to filter out fake reports
Enhance program guidelines to prevent AI exploitation
articles.telegram_snippet: Google suspends open-source bug bounty program due to AI-generated report surge, highlighting the growing challenge of AI-powered attacks on cybersecurity programs.

articles.title: Trump Names National Intelligence Director Jay Clayton to Lead a New Federal AI Task Force
articles.executive_summary: US President Trump has established a new federal AI task force, led by National Intelligence Director Jay Clayton. The task force aims to promote the development and use of AI in the US government.
articles.technical_breakdown: The announcement follows a meeting between Trump and top AI executives at the White House. The task force will focus on AI research and development, as well as its applications in government.
